name: session-relay
description: Passes prompts from a planning session to the session that does the work and its answers back, without copy and paste

minPromptChars.title: Shortest prompt block (characters)
minPromptChars.description: A fenced block in the lead's answer is offered for sending from this length on; shorter blocks are usually commands or snippets.

notify.title: Notify when the worker answers
notify.description: Raise a notification in the lead session when an answer from the worker arrives, besides the toast.
